name: Parallax-barrier and Lenticular Display Calibration
definition: A procedure to automatically calibrate the position of a parallax-barrier with respect to the underlying rear-projection image using a digital camera and homography.
summary: Parallax-barrier and Lenticular Display Calibration is an automated procedure using a digital camera and homography to precisely align a laser-cut barrier with rear-projection sub-pixels, differing from manual alignment by using computer-guided image processing.
